paras: Microlophus yanezi, commonly called Yanez's lava lizard, is a species of lizard in the family Tropiduridae. The species is endemic to the Chilean Matorral within the nation of Chile.
The specific name, yanezi, is in honor of Chilean zoologist José Lautaro Yáñez-Valenzuela (born 1951).
The preferred natural habitat of M. yanezi is desert, at altitudes from sea level to 2,800 m (9,200 ft).
